cases.prompt: Help me align my category definitions and keep them consistent across my finance skills.
success_criteria: Uses the shared glossary and current category list rather than inventing definitions from labels alone.

cases.prompt: Which category should I use for this one grocery-store purchase?
success_criteria: Routes a single transaction classification to transaction cleanup unless it exposes a taxonomy-definition gap.

cases.prompt: The live Monarch list has a new custom category called Example Home Services that is absent from the glossary. Reconcile the category and glossary.
success_criteria: Identifies the missing definition and asks the user to define or review it.
Drafts a glossary change for review rather than writing it without approval.
Does not change a Monarch category before exact confirmation.
Preserves household-wide impact and custom/system uncertainty.

cases.prompt: The category tool does not identify whether a requested category is system or custom. The user asks to rename it and approves the new name.
success_criteria: Does not attempt the update until a trusted source confirms the category is custom.
Explains the tool limitation and provides a proposal-only path.
Does not treat user confirmation as proof that the tool supports the mutation.
